ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial records of child care programs in Minnesota and other states to identify potential cases of fraud.
questions: How much money has been lost to child care fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common schemes used to commit child care fraud?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial records of child care programs, we may be able to identify patterns and anomalies that indicate fraudulent activity. This could lead to a larger investigation and potentially recover millions of dollars in lost funds.
